title: DNA Purification from a PCR Product Using NucleoSpin® PCR Clean-up Kit
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jahkie

steps.title: Adjust sample volume and bind DNA
steps.instruction: If the PCR reaction volume is less than 30 µL, bring the total volume to 50–100 µL with water (no need to remove mineral oil). Mix the sample with Buffer NTI at a 1:2 ratio (e.g., 100 µL PCR + 200 µL Buffer NTI). For removal of small fragments such as primer dimers, diluted Buffer NTI may be used instead of 100 % Buffer NTI. Incubate the mixture at 50 °C for 5–10 minutes or until the agarose gel has completely melted.

steps.title: Load sample onto column and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Place a NucleoSpin® PCR clean‑up Gel column into the provided 2 mL collection tube. Apply up to 700 µL of the DNA/agarose solution to the column and centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature. Discard the flow‑through and return the column to the same collection tube. If the total volume exceeds 700 µL, repeat the loading and centrifugation steps in 700 µL aliquots. Each column can bind up to 25 µg DNA; for larger expected yields, split the sample among multiple columns.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer NT3 (first)
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of Buffer NT3 to the column, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature, then discard the flow‑through. Re‑use the same collection tube for the next wash.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer NT3 (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash: add another 700 µL of Buffer NT3, centrifuge at 11 000 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column to remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard any remaining liquid and centrifuge the empty column for 1 minute at 11 000 × g to dry the matrix. This step is critical for removing residual ethanol, which can inhibit downstream enzymatic reactions. If desired, incubate the column for 2–5 minutes at 70 °C before elution to ensure complete ethanol removal.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the column into a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube. Add 15–30 µL of Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.5) directly onto the matrix, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge for 1 minute at 11 000 × g to collect the eluate (≈70 % of bound DNA). An optional second elution with fresh buffer can be performed to recover residual DNA at lower concentration. For fragments larger than 1000 bp, DNA recovery can be increased by performing multiple elution steps with fresh buffer, heating to 70 °C, and incubating for 5 minutes each.
